concerns.text: FR-003 explicitly requires a two‑sample Kolmogorov‑Smirnov (KS) test on shear‑band aggregated D²_min values. The task list (e.g., T025‑T029) implements a Permutation Test instead and logs a deviation note (T026‑log) without an authorized spec amendment. This leaves the original acceptance scenario for US‑2 (KS‑test statistic and p‑value) uncovered, constituting a weakening of the functional requirement.

The plan marks FR‑006 as '[deferred]' while the task list (e.g., T002, T006) enforces the particle‑count limit. This inconsistency should be reconciled—either update the plan to reflect that FR‑006 is active or adjust the tasks to match the deferred status.
